required.quote: An applicant seeking licensure as a respiratory care practitioner shall: (a) submit an application on a form prescribed by the division; (b) pay a fee as determined by the department pursuant to Section 63J-1-504; (c) possess a high school education or its equivalent, as determined by the division in collaboration with the board; and (d) have completed a respiratory care practitioner educational program that is accredited by a nationally accredited organization acceptable to the division as defined by rule; and (e) pass an examination approved by the division in collaboration with the board.

exams.name: examination approved by the division in collaboration with the board
exams.notes: Exam approved by the division in collaboration with the Respiratory Care Licensing Board
exams.quote: pass an examination approved by the division in collaboration with the board

interval_years.quote: Each license issued under this chapter shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.
interval_years.citation: Section 6 - Term of license -- Expiration -- Renewal.

available.quote: the board may recommend that the division issue a license without examination to any applicant currently licensed by another state as a respiratory care practitioner or its equivalent, if the requirements for licensing in that state are at least as stringent as the requirements under this chapter.

requirements.value: Applicant must have completed a respiratory care practitioner education program approved by the board and accredited by a nationally accredited organization acceptable to the division; must be currently licensed by another state as a respiratory care practitioner or equivalent; and the other state's requirements must be at least as stringent as Utah's.
requirements.quote: the board may recommend that the division issue a license without examination to any applicant currently licensed by another state as a respiratory care practitioner or its equivalent, if the requirements for licensing in that state are at least as stringent as the requirements under this chapter.

exists.quote: "Board" means the Respiratory Care Licensing Board created in Section 58-57-3.

title_protection.quote: Only a respiratory care practitioner may use the following titles or designations in this state: (a) respiratory care practitioner; (b) respiratory therapist; or (c) respiratory technician.

scope_protection.quote: any person who is engaged in the practice of respiratory care as defined in Section 58-57-2 and who is not licensed under this chapter as a respiratory care practitioner, shall by January 1, 2007, obtain a license under this chapter unless exempt from licensure under the provisions of Section 58-1-307 or 58-57-7.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting contrary to the instructions of the supervising practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acting contrary to the instructions of the practitioner responsible for supervising the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly operating respiratory care equipment that is unsafe or not in compliance with safety standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly operating any respiratory care equipment that is unsafe or not in compliance with standards of condition or operation consistent with the patient's safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting any person to operate respiratory care equipment who is not competent or not allowed to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: permitting any person to operate respiratory care equipment who is not competent or not allowed to operate the equipment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revealing confidential or privileged patient information to unauthorized persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revealing to any unauthorized person confidential or privileged information about a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using any controlled substance unless prescribed by a practitioner and used in accordance with instructions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using any controlled substance, unless the controlled substance is prescribed by a practitioner and used in accordance with the practitioner's instructions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making incorrect statements due to negligence, willfulness, or intent to provide false information on patient or payment records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making any statement that is incorrect due to negligence, willfulness, or intent to provide false information or entry on any patient record or other record that is used for payment of respiratory care services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Grounds for denial, refusal to renew, revocation, suspension, restriction, probation, reprimand, or cease and desist as specified in Section 58-1-401
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Grounds for refusal to issue a license to an applicant, for refusal to renew the license of a licensee, to revoke, suspend, restrict, or place on probation the license of a licensee, to issue a public or private reprimand to a licensee, and to issue cease and desist orders shall be in accordance with Section 58-1-401.

definition_quote.value: the treatment, operation of equipment, management, diagnostic testing, and care of any human disease, deficiency, pain, injury, or other physical condition associated with the cardiopulmonary system under the qualified medical direction or supervision of a practitioner who has training and knowledge in the diagnosis, treatment, and assessment of respiratory problems
definition_quote.quote: the treatment, operation of equipment, management, diagnostic testing, and care of any human disease, deficiency, pain, injury, or other physical condition associated with the cardiopulmonary system under the qualified medical direction or supervision of a practitioner who has training and knowledge in the diagnosis, treatment, and assessment of respiratory problems

value: accepting and carrying out a practitioner's written, verbal, or telephonic prescription or order specifically relating to respiratory care
administering respiratory care during transportation of a patient and under emergency circumstances
serving as a resource to other health care professionals and hospital administrators
functioning in situations of patient contact requiring individual judgment under general supervision
supervising, directing, or teaching personnel in respiratory care modalities as part of a respiratory care education program
methods_authorized.quote: includes: (i) accepting and carrying out a practitioner's written, verbal, or telephonic prescription or order specifically relating to respiratory care in a hospital or other health care setting and includes consultation with licensed nurses, as appropriate; (ii) administering respiratory care during transportation of a patient and under other circumstances where an emergency requires immediate respiratory care; (iii) serving as a resource to other health care professionals and hospital administrators in relation to the technical aspects of, and the safe and effective methods for, administering respiratory care; (iv) functioning in situations of patient contact requiring individual judgment in administering respiratory care under the general supervision of a qualified practitioner; and (v) supervising, directing, or teaching personnel in the performance of respiratory care modalities as part of a respiratory care education program

medical_direction_required.quote: under the qualified medical direction or supervision of a practitioner who has training and knowledge in the diagnosis, treatment, and assessment of respiratory problems

independent_practice_prohibited.quote: A respiratory care practitioner may not: (1) practice independently of a practitioner or of a health care facility while under the supervision of a practitioner; or (2) charge a fee for his services independently of a practitioner or health care facility.

durable_medical_equipment_exclusion.quote: does not include a person who delivers, installs, or maintains respiratory related durable medical equipment and who gives instructions regarding the use of that equipment as long as that person does not perform clinical evaluation or treatment of the patient.
